title: What Balanced Accuracy Cannot Identify in Neural-Signal Decoding under Test-Time Adaptation
abstract: arXiv:2611.17925v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Adaptation for neural-signal classification is usually transductive: each batch is scored after updating on it, and the gain depends on the adapted model [4]. This paper asks what an aggregate change fails to characterise inside the cohort. Full test-time adaptation (full_ttt) was evaluated in 11 dataset-encoder cells (four each on Siena/EEG and PTB-XL/ECG, three on Sleep-EDF/EEG), with splits and source-model evaluation fixed; the subject was the unit, exact sign tests were Holm-corrected and conditional on the shared stream, and bootstrap intervals accompanied a dependence audit. Two results of different kinds follow. translated_title: 测试时自适应下神经信号解码中平衡准确率无法识别的问题
translated_abstract: 神经信号分类的适配通常是直推式的：每个批次在完成更新后才进行评分，其增益依赖于适配后的模型。本文探讨的是，总体指标的变化无法刻画队列内部哪些问题。全文测试时自适应（full_ttt）在11个数据集-编码器组合单元上进行了评估（Siena/EEG和PTB-XL/ECG各4个单元，Sleep-EDF/EEG 3个单元），数据划分与源模型评估保持固定；以受试者为分析单元，精确符号检验经Holm校正并以共享数据流为条件，同时通过自助法区间进行了依赖性审计。研究得出两类不同性质的结果。在二分类情形下，平衡准确率会给只报告单一类别的解码器与在50%水平上报告两个类别的解码器相同的分值，因此总体指标无法识别出不再被报告的类别；一个占受试者样本约十分之一的类别，在112个受试者单元中有26-47个出现完全无法预测的情况，而对照组仅为7-9个。
tldr: 本文揭示在测试时自适应的神经信号解码评估中，平衡准确率等总体指标存在盲区——仅报告单一类别的解码器可获得与正常50%平衡解码器相同的分数，且占样本约十分之一的类别在112个受试者单元中有26-47个完全无法被预测。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that under test-time adaptation in neural-signal decoding, balanced accuracy as an aggregate metric cannot detect class-reporting failures—a one-class decoder scores identically to a proper 50% balanced decoder, and a class covering a tenth of a subject's samples went completely unpredicted in 26-47 of 112 subject-cells.
